Building and bases

Secure a small core before expanding to a 2×2 base

Build in two stages. First bring enough materials to close and lock a small core with a Tool Cupboard, door, basic storage and respawn point. Store your first gathering haul there. Later, when you know what materials and nearby player activity allow, expand toward a full 2×2 layout, add rooms and strengthen the outer walls.

This order reduces the time you stand in the open holding building materials. Before expanding, use the placement preview to check door swing, internal walkways and the Tool Cupboard position. Filling the core with boxes too early may leave no room for a door or stairs. In a team, agree who brings doors and upkeep materials.

A creator’s “five-minute build” depends on practice, supplies and server conditions. The useful idea is to secure the core first and expand afterward; the time claim is not a guarantee.
